context.narrative_job: Let the presenter and working diagnostic feel like a direct explanation instead of a framed presentation.
context.viewer_before: The 43.541667-second screen-led cut retains a 150-pixel channel and series banner plus an 84-pixel footer on every frame, including the talking-head opening and approved end card.
context.viewer_after: The opening and conclusion read as a conversation, and the full-screen sheets carry the practical demonstration without a persistent episode label.

data.choice: Remove the root-level identity rail, channel and series docket, and footer throughout Short 01. Retain timed captions, scene-local question and working labels that teach the diagnostic, the bounded payoff qualification on the map, and the exact owner-approved end-card copy. Preserve every scene and media time, presenter source range, script, audio and caption timing.
data.reason: The persistent bands repeat context already spoken and shown in the opening, then visually contain every screen like a slide deck. The scene-local text has a separate job: it names the question, owner-held examples, handoff conditions and bounded payoff. Removing the repeated frame is the smallest edit that addresses the owner's naturalness feedback without losing the cold-viewer explanation.

alternatives.choice: Keep the channel banner but show it only at the start.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: The presenter and opening copy already introduce the topic, while even a brief banner competes with the direct-to-camera invitation.

alternatives.choice: Remove every heading and all designed text.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: The thirty-day question, circle-every-I examples and three handoff questions need visible wording to make the diagnostic usable without assuming episode context.

alternatives.choice: Revise the narration or regenerate presenter footage to feel less produced.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: The feedback identifies a visual wrapper; the current spoken performance and timing are already locked and correctly synchronized.

reuse.applies_when: Revising the current EP007 Short 01 screen-led render after owner review of its persistent top and bottom bands.
reuse.avoid_when: Treating this as a universal no-branding rule for other Shorts or removing text that carries the mechanism.

nuance.picture_audio_mode: presenter_address opens and concludes; silent_graphic explains the working diagnostic; the end bridge remains visual-only
nuance.protected_hold: The final spoken word ends at 40.895 seconds, the standalone answer holds through 41.541667 seconds, and the end card lasts two seconds.
nuance.false_inference: The example sheets remain an illustrative working diagnostic, not proof of readiness, sale, valuation or client demand.
nuance.source_basis: Current owner's exact phone-review feedback, the v21 technically verified render, current root composition, and the v20 exact screen-led picture contract.

data.approval_boundary: This is a reversible Short 01 picture-chrome revision within existing through-render authority. The resulting video still needs owner acceptance; release, upload, publication, episode URL, Related Video binding and Shorts 2 through 4 provider work remain outside this decision.
